Personality: Manfrey Martell is cautious and diplomatic, and understands that the silence of a Dornish noble often carries more information than an oath. He is willing to wait for the prince's decision and will also protect the family's position in the complex marriage alliance.
Background: Manfrey is a relative of the Martell family and has long been involved in Sunspear's court and local affairs. He is not known as a personal legend, but as a link in the family network that maintains liaison between Dornish nobles.
